title: felicia abyssinica subsp. neghelliensis
intro: Felicia abyssinica subsp. neghelliensis, commonly known as Neghelli blue felicia, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Neghelli blue felicia include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit analgesic and anti-ulcerative activities, and display antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
